No other object in the 9/28-9/30 window is a correction of any kind, numbered or unnumbered: #13-15 are certificates of service, #16 is a notice of related case, and #18-21 and the clerk's reviews are pro hac vice items. The timing fits: the short object was created at 10:34:58 and #17 at 10:55:50, #17 has no time_filed of its own, and 10:09 falls between #16 (07:31) and #18 (the next day).

The short form 'Order on Motion for Stay' matches the long form, #24: an ORDER granting the Unopposed Motion for Stay (ECF No. 22), entered 10/02/2025. It is the same kind of order on the same type of motion, on the same day. It is the only order on a stay motion in the 10/1-10/3 window: #22 is the motion itself, and #23 and its document short form are pro hac vice orders. The two objects were created 30 seconds apart (17:24:25 and 17:24:55), and #24 has no time_filed of its own. The order text calls the motion 'Defendant's' although the United States filed #22. That is an error inside the order text, and the short form does not contradict it.

The short form '1 - Scheduling' (unnumbered, filed 10/31 12:53:20, created in CourtListener at 13:18:49) reads as the label of a court scheduling-order event.
